entries.title: Job 16:1
segments: ¶And Job made answer and said,

entries.title: Job 16:2
segments: Such things have frequently come to my ears: you are comforters who only give trouble.

entries.title: Job 16:3
segments: May words which are like the wind be stopped? or what is troubling you to make answer to them?

entries.title: Job 16:4
segments: It would not be hard for me to say such things if your souls were in my soul's place; joining words together against you, and shaking my head at you:

entries.title: Job 16:5
segments: I might give you strength with my mouth, and not keep back the comfort of my lips.

entries.title: Job 16:6
segments: ¶If I say what is in my mind, my pain becomes no less: and if I keep quiet, how much of it goes from me?

entries.title: Job 16:7
segments: But now he has overcome me with weariness and fear, and I am in the grip of all my trouble.

entries.title: Job 16:8
segments: It has come up as a witness against me, and the wasting of my flesh makes answer to my face.

entries.title: Job 16:9
segments: I am broken by his wrath, and his hate has gone after me; he has made his teeth sharp against me: my haters are looking on me with cruel eyes;

entries.title: Job 16:10
segments: Their mouths are open wide against me; the blows of his bitter words are falling on my face; all of them come together in a mass against me.

entries.title: Job 16:11
segments: God gives me over to the power of sinners, sending me violently into the hands of evil-doers.

entries.title: Job 16:12
segments: I was in comfort, but I have been broken up by his hands; he has taken me by the neck, shaking me to bits; he has put me up as a mark for his arrows.

entries.title: Job 16:13
segments: His bowmen come round about me; their arrows go through my body without mercy; my life is drained out on the earth.

entries.title: Job 16:14
segments: I am broken with wound after wound; he comes rushing on me like a man of war.

entries.title: Job 16:15
segments: I have made haircloth the clothing of my skin, and my horn is rolled in the dust.

entries.title: Job 16:16
segments: My face is red with weeping, and my eyes are becoming dark;

entries.title: Job 16:17
segments: ¶Though my hands have done no violent acts, and my prayer is clean.

entries.title: Job 16:18
segments: O earth, let not my blood be covered, and let my cry have no resting-place!

entries.title: Job 16:19
segments: Even now my witness is in heaven, and the supporter of my cause is on high.

entries.title: Job 16:20
segments: My friends make sport of me; to God my eyes are weeping,

entries.title: Job 16:21
segments: So that he may give decision for a man in his cause with God, and between a son of man and his neighbour.

entries.title: Job 16:22
segments: For in a short time I will take the journey from which I will not come back.
